I just love the way spreadsheets work, and I need them and I use them.

Google sheets makes the occasional excel attachment review on email easy.

Except for working on huge lists,

For an app that works on my iPhone and my PC simultaneously , I can't be happier using it for reviews and the small lists of data I need to share with co-workers.

I will try the new Microsoft excel on iOS and decide what works better. That one needs a subscription , google sheets has been free since it came out. 

Keep it up!
